note: The parts of the fixed CAEPIPE sitting pack, in the order the owner runs them; parts are struck from the last backwards, and part 1 is never struck, only shortened from its highest strike numbers. Read by tools/caepipe_correlation/sitting_pack_build.py, a development tool; the reviewed pack is the committed folder validation/caepipe_sitting_pack.

parts.title: Dry run
parts.buys: Three small first-tranche cases taken through the batch route one line at a time, with your own comparison of the first print's section titles with the short list, and two samples of one dynamics run file: one run by the batch command, one opened in the program's window for the observations the benchmark manifest lists. By the benchmark manifest's consequences, its answers decide how parts 1 and 4 are run.

parts.title: Dynamics runs
parts.buys: The modal and response-spectrum runs of tranche 3, in the benchmark manifest's strike order. Each pair has two forms, each in its own folder, and one case is declared in one form only; every case of this part is run in the program's window only.

parts.title: Pressurised series
parts.buys: The declared screened runs of the cases that carry the exact pressure contract, each model's pressure-default run next to its pressure-elongation-on run, then the declared capture-only runs (pressure-bourdon-expansion-capture), which are sealed captures.

parts.title: Series S1, S2 and S3
parts.buys: The three linear static one-parameter series of tranche 3: transverse shear in straight pipe (S1), shear and flexibility in a bend (S2) and the finite stiffness of a rigid support (S3), each series' members together.

parts.title: Hand-entry cases
parts.buys: The five cases whose one support member is entered by hand on a written base, in the benchmark manifest's rank order, in the program's window only.

parts.title: Tranche 1 remainder
parts.buys: The first tranche's other models, by family, the members of one series next to each other and smaller models first.
